messages:
Alex: Deployed runtime change a few minutes ago (auto-tune microbatch + kvcache pipeline). Seeing p99 jump ~220ms on small-seq workloads. Anyone else?

install-bot: Deployed: runtime-service v2.14.0 by @Alex at 2026-03-16T01:23Z :rocket:

Mei: Yep alert at 01:28. p50 steady, p95 +30ms, p99 +220ms. Tail heavier. Traces point to kernel selection for sequences <32.

Sam: Quick profiling (live trace) — looks like attention kernel choice + queueing. Snippet: 
```
seq<=32: kernel=fused_attn_v2 latency=3.1ms (expected ~1.1ms)
seq>32: kernel=matmul_attn latency=7.9ms (unchanged)
microbatch=16 avg_queue_wait=2.4ms
kvcache_hit=92% but miss path added 0.6ms
```

Mei: fused_attn_v2 was promoted in autoselect heuristics. It has higher launch/SM setup overhead; for tiny sequences it regresses. Also auto-tune bumped microbatch to 16 which increases queue latency for p99. Two risky changes in one deploy.

Alex: Oof. Can we gate or rollback fast? Can we force microbatch=8 and force kernel hint to legacy for small seqs?

Sam: I can hotpatch a canary with `--microbatch-size=8` + `--kernel-hint=legacy_smallseq`. Will test on canary now.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0316-004 — runtime p99 regression (assigned to @Sam) :rotating_light:

Sam: Hotpatch applied to svc-runtime-canary. Canary p99 dropped back to baseline within 90s. Traces show kernel fallback and queueing reduced.

Ravi: Preparing prod rollout of the hotpatch. Doing rolling restart with flags. ETA ~4m.

deploy-bot: Rollout started by @Ravi: force microbatch=8, kernel-hint=legacy_smallseq.

Alex: Observability confirms prod p99 back to baseline after restart. :thumbsup: Marking this as rollback of the auto-tune + kernel autoselect change.

Mei: Follow-ups:
- Add microbench for small-seq fused_attn_v2 latency across cores.
- Update autoselect to incorporate launch/overhead model + seq distribution weighting.
- Add p99 smoke tests for microbatch/autotune changes in CI.
I'll file a ticket.

Sam: Filed PERF-982: "small-seq kernel vetting + microbatch SLO gating". Linking to INC-2026-0316-004 and assigning to eng-runtime.

Alex: Lesson: don't bundle kernel autoselect + microbatch tuning in the same deploy. Add to deploy checklist: 1) perf canary, 2) p99 smoke, 3) staged kernel rollout.

Ravi: Closing incident after postmortem created. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
